description: This PHP source file defines the UpgraderCompleteController class, which manages the upgrade completion screen in the installer module of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller and prepares a Vue.js component for rendering the upgrade completion interface, also handling state and logging.

classes.name: UpgraderCompleteController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing and rendering the upgrade complete screen in the OrangeHRM installer process.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component for the upgrade completion screen, updates the application state, and logs the current installation status.
